description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Work on performance-critical systems software written in C++, owning core library development and production troubleshooting. The role combines applied research, performance analysis and hands-on engineering in a fast-moving startup setting.
 What you'll do
 - Develop and maintain the core C++ library at the heart of a systems software platform.
 - Research techniques for resource sharing, state snapshotting and high-performance GPU systems.
 - Add support for new hardware architectures, drawing on a deep understanding of the full system.
 - Debug systems-level issues in live production environments.
 - Diagnose performance problems in customer workloads and trace them across the stack.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Hands-on background shipping and supporting close-to-the-hardware software in live environments.
 - Expert-level C++ skills; strong Rust experience may also be considered, though day-to-day work is in C++.
 - Experience tuning network interface and C++ performance.
 - Ability to follow performance problems through every layer of the stack.
 - A strong academic record in computer science from a highly regarded university.
 - A history of delivering quickly in an early-stage startup.
 Bonus points
 - Exposure to compilers, networking protocols or operating system kernels.
 - Kubernetes or infrastructure experience, for example storage systems work or large-scale data ingestion.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 215,000 to 325,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
